text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Yaeno-san. What a coincidence.
What book are you reading?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's a martial arts manual. The original was written
over 100 years ago, and it's absolutely fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A martial arts manual... and one written over
100 years ago at that. It sounds like quite a difficult read.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I thought so at first too, but many of them have modern translations, so they're surprisingly easy to read.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Besides, it also includes ways to train your mind and other things you can apply to races.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like,
shall I recommend a few martial arts books?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, I'm so pleased. If it's no trouble,
I'll gladly take you up on your kind offer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll go pick out some books right away.
If you ever take an interest in martial arts,
let's train together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You would teach me?
I have never had the chance to learn martial arts, so I am delighted.
If so, I shall address you as "Master" from now on.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, I am still far too inexperienced,
and unworthy of being called 'Master.'

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So let us push each other to greater heights as rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Understood. I will devote myself to catching up to you, Yaeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, having thoroughly read the recommended martial arts book,
Mejiro Ardan gained many new insights.
